title: Another Word for "Help": 3 Better Words #shorts
description:
Another word for "help" in English. Don't just say "Help". Here are three better words:
• Assist. (to help with a task)
• Aid. (to give needed help)
• Guide. (to show the way)

Want more words for help? Watch the full lesson on this channel: Another Word For Help
